title: Torsion cohomology comparison from the small etale to the big ph site
statement:
Let $T$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Use its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and the big ph site [def-trf-ph-scheme-site], in the size convention [def-weil-size-convention]. The inclusion of etale $T$-schemes into all $T$-schemes induces a geometric morphism $h_T:\mathrm{Sh}((\mathrm{Sch}/T)_{ph})\to\mathrm{Sh}(T_{\mathrm{Et}})$ [def-trf-geometric-morphism]. For every $K\in D^+(\mathrm{Ab}(T_{\mathrm{Et}}))$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-abstract-derived-category] whose cohomology sheaves are torsion, the ordinary derived adjunction unit
$$\eta_{h_T,K}:K\longrightarrow Rh_{T,*}h_T^{-1}K$$
is an isomorphism. Torsion means that every local section of every cohomology sheaf is locally killed by a positive integer, with no single annihilator required.

source.place: Tag 0DE5, lemma-cohomological-descent-etale-ph; morphism h_T=a_T=pi_T composed with epsilon_T in section-ph-etale.

proof.text: Use $B_T$ and $\pi=\pi_T$ from [lem-trf-big-small-etale-exact-retraction], and $\epsilon=\epsilon_T$ from [lem-trf-ph-big-etale-torsion-acyclicity]. The current definition [def-trf-ph-scheme-site] presents the ph site on the same category of schemes over $T$, with its topology generated by Zariski covers and proper surjective singletons. Their composite $\pi\circ\epsilon$ is $h=h_T$: the composite functor on sites is exactly the inclusion of small etale $T$-schemes into all $T$-schemes. Consequently $h^{-1}=\epsilon^{-1}\pi^{-1}$ and $h_*=\pi_*\epsilon_*$ with the composite adjunction, as in [def-trf-geometric-morphism]. Work throughout with compatible small presentations in the common larger universe. Abelian sheaves on all three sites are Grothendieck abelian, by [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist] applied to the integer sheaf; the same statement supplies K-injective resolutions by termwise injectives. Thus the ordinary derived direct images and the composition normalization below apply. All inverse images are exact.

source.place: section-ph-etale, construction of a_T; 0DE5 proof, factorization through the big etale site.

proof.text: First let $F$ be a torsion abelian sheaf on $T_{\mathrm{Et}}$, placed in degree zero. Put $G=\pi^{-1}F$. By [lem-trf-ph-big-etale-torsion-acyclicity], the underived $\epsilon$-unit $G\to\epsilon_*\epsilon^{-1}G$ is invertible and $\epsilon^{-1}G$ is $\epsilon_*$-acyclic. The acyclic-complex comparison [src-right-derived-functor-plus-acyclic-unit], applied to this single sheaf, makes $\epsilon_*\epsilon^{-1}G\to R\epsilon_*\epsilon^{-1}G$ invertible. Their composite is the ordinary derived $\epsilon$-unit: in the canonical derived Hom bijection [lem-pc-derived-adjoint-functors] it is the transpose of the identity of $\epsilon^{-1}G$. The unit $F\to R\pi_*\pi^{-1}F$ is invertible by [lem-trf-big-small-etale-exact-retraction]: exactness of $\pi_*$ means its termwise application preserves kernels, images and cohomology, so computes its derived functor, and its underived unit is an isomorphism.

source.place: 0DE5 proof, sheaf case using 0DE4(1) and 0DDI; 015E for the canonical acyclic comparison.

proof.text:
Apply [lem-sfb-derived-composition-adjunction-normalization] to the exact inverse images $\pi^{-1},\epsilon^{-1},h^{-1}$ and the composition identification of step 1. Its comparison $Rh_*\simeq R\pi_*R\epsilon_*$ carries the actual derived $h$-unit at $F$ to
$$F\xrightarrow{\eta_{\pi,F}}R\pi_*\pi^{-1}F\xrightarrow{R\pi_*(\eta_{\epsilon,\pi^{-1}F})}R\pi_*R\epsilon_*\epsilon^{-1}\pi^{-1}F.$$
Both arrows are invertible by step 2, so $\eta_{h,F}$ is invertible. In particular $R^qh_*(h^{-1}F)=0$ for $q>0$ and the ordinary unit $F\to h_*h^{-1}F$ is invertible. Indeed the cohomology in positive degrees of $F[0]$ is zero, and in degree zero the derived unit is the ordinary adjunction unit. This proves precisely the sheaf case needed below, without requiring that $F$ be killed by one integer.

source.place: 0DE5 proof, Leray step; equivalently the canonical derived composition comparison and composite-unit formula (09T5 and 0D6E).

proof.text: For the given $K$, apply [lem-trf-torsion-sheaf-complex-representative] on $T_{\mathrm{Et}}$ to choose $K\simeq Q(L^\bullet)$ with $L^r=0$ for $r<a$ and every $L^r$ a torsion sheaf. The exact inverse image $h^{-1}$ takes this representative to $E^\bullet=h^{-1}L^\bullet$, with $E^r=0$ for $r<a$. By step 3 every $E^r$ is $h_*$-acyclic and each ordinary unit $L^r\to h_*E^r$ is an isomorphism. Naturality of the underived unit with respect to $d_L^r$ says $h_*h^{-1}(d_L^r)\eta_{L^r}=\eta_{L^{r+1}}d_L^r$; hence these maps form an isomorphism of complexes $L^\bullet\to h_*E^\bullet$.

source.place: 0DE5 proof, first paragraph, using 0DD7 and the sheaf case.

proof.text: The categories of abelian sheaves have enough injectives by [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaves-enough-injectives]. Apply [src-right-derived-functor-plus-acyclic-unit] to the bounded-below $h_*$-acyclic complex $E^\bullet$ of step 4. The canonical comparison $\delta_E:Q(h_*E^\bullet)\to Rh_*Q(E^\bullet)$ is an isomorphism. Compose it with $Q(\eta^0_L):Q(L^\bullet)\to Q(h_*E^\bullet)$ from step 4. This composite is $\eta_{h,Q(L)}$. To check the specified map, compute the canonical derived Hom bijection of [lem-pc-derived-adjoint-functors] on a K-injective resolution $j:E^\bullet\to I^\bullet$ supplied by [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist]. The composite is represented by $h_*(j)\eta^0_L:L^\bullet\to h_*I^\bullet$, whose ordinary transpose is $j$. After localization this transpose is the identity of $Q(E^\bullet)$ under $Q(j)$, exactly the defining transpose of the derived adjunction unit. Thus $\eta_{h,Q(L)}$ is an isomorphism. Finally naturality of $\eta_h$ along the chosen isomorphism $Q(L)\simeq K$ proves that $\eta_{h,K}$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: 0DE5 proof, Leray acyclicity (015E); 09T5 canonical derived adjunction for identifying the actual unit.

split_report.summary: Expanded Stacks 0DE5 into five steps through the big etale site, tracking the actual adjunction unit. Added three strictly smaller statement-only inputs: exact small/big etale restriction, epsilon-acyclicity for etale-origin torsion sheaves, and a termwise-torsion representative. Reused the existing acyclic-complex and canonical-derived-adjunction statements; no statement change, no uniform torsion or invertibility hypothesis, no Lean edits. Corrected the reversed composite in the source proof without changing its theorem. Revalidated after the current def-trf-ph-scheme-site definition changed: step 1 now cites its explicit Zariski/proper-surjective topology statement.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the retained ancestry from lem-trf-local-term-locality, normal-cone specialization, through Orgogozo Lemma 3.1.1 first cohomological-descent isomorphism and Stacks 0DHL. The component and base comparisons needed there are supplied by the present five steps.

tool_uses.why: Generic Grothendieck property and K-injective resolutions for integer-module sheaves on the three small-presented sites; needed to compute ordinary derived adjunctions and their composition.
Generic Leray acyclicity comparison for a bounded-below complex; supplies exactly the canonical map, independent of etale geometry.
Generic canonical derived Hom bijection identifies the acyclic comparison composed with the underived unit as the actual derived adjunction unit.
Generic composition normalization of derived adjunctions identifies the h-unit with the pi/epsilon composite unit; no statement in this unit gives this general algebra.
Generic existence of injectives on a small site supplies the hypothesis of the bounded-below acyclic-complex theorem.
